sourceCode.label: {filename} source
sourceCode.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the code and copy it manually.

badge.description: A small label for a status or category.

button.description: A button that can be rendered as another element and can stay focusable while disabled.

combobox.description: A form control for typing to filter options and choosing one from the list.

dialog.description: A popup that opens on top of the entire page.

drawer.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the page; the page stays in view behind it.

field.description: Groups a label, control, description, and error message; TanStack Form supplies the state.

form.description: A form that validates its fields on submit and focuses the first invalid one.

input.description: A native input element that works with Field automatically when placed inside it.

menu.description: A set of actions or choices a button opens, which can be grouped; closeOnClick decides whether picking one closes it.

popover.description: A panel that opens beside an element when it is pressed, holding a title, a description, or a few controls; a press outside or Escape closes it.

progress.description: Shows the progress of a long-running operation.

radio-group.description: A set of choices of which one is picked; the arrow keys move between them.

select.description: A form control for choosing a predefined value from a dropdown menu.

skeleton.description: A placeholder shown while content is loading.

switch.description: A control that indicates whether a setting is on or off.

table.description: Rows of data on a panel that scrolls sideways when it is wider than the page.

tabs.description: A set of tabs that switch between views, which can also render as links between a page's URL states.

textarea.description: A multi-line text input that works with Field automatically when placed inside it.

toaster.description: A brief message that appears temporarily and stacks with others.

toggle.description: A button that is either pressed or not, such as a formatting option.

tooltip.description: A short label that appears beside an element under the pointer or on keyboard focus.
